description: Prediction-Market Clarification Impact Pricer — Prices a prediction-market rules clarification as a trade. Given an open Polymarket market (slug, URL or conditionId; Kalshi ticker supported), reads the posted clarification (Additional context) from the UMA adapter on Polygon, or takes your clarificationText to price a pending or hypothetical one. Finds the real-world outcomes whose resolution changed, quotes each changed clause verbatim, shifts

bankrollUsd.description: Used to turn the Kelly fraction into dollars.

clarificationText.description: The clarification / Additional context text. Overrides the on-chain read.

feeRate.description: Taker fee coefficient: fee = shares * feeRate * p * (1 - p). Defaults to the market's Gamma feeSchedule rate (0 when fees are disabled); Kalshi defaults to 0.07 times the series fee_multiplier from /series.

kellyFraction.description: Fraction of full Kelly to stake (default 0.25).

market.description: Polymarket market slug, polymarket.com URL or conditionId; or a Kalshi market ticker (rules from the public trade-api v2).

minEdgeBps.description: Minimum edge after fees and slippage, in bps of cost (default 100).

minMoveBps.description: Fair-value move below which the answer is NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE (default 100).

outcome.description: Held side; YES is the market's first outcome.

priorYes.description: Override for the pre-clarification fair P(YES); default is the Polymarket CLOB price history just before the clarification, falling back to the current YES order-book mid.

rulesBefore.description: Rules text before the change. Overrides the on-chain read; defaults to the creation-time rules plus earlier updates.

name: clarification-impact
